question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Hostility
solution:
The correct answer is '**Friendship**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word '**Hostility**' refers to an unfriendly or aggressive attitude or action. (द्वेष)
 
• The correct antonym, '**Friendship**', stands for a state of mutual trust and support. (मित्रता)
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for '**Hostility**' is '**Friendship**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is- “**Option 4**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Silliness**' refers to the state of being foolish or lacking common sense. (मूर्खता)
 
• '**Enmity**' means a state or feeling of active opposition or hostility. (शत्रुता)
 
• '**Absurdity**' means the quality of being ridiculously unreasonable or nonsensical. (बेतुकापन)
